headline: Petition by National Grid to install a utility pole on Madison Avenue, and acceptance of a $425,000 LAND Grant for Magnolia Reserve Conservation.
summary: A National Grid request for new pole and wire work on Madison Avenue is back for review after being continued from November 4, 2026. A memo asks to accept a LAND Grant award for conservation work at Magnolia Reserve.
items: PP2026-012: National Grid petition to install a JO pole on Madison Avenue, about 120 feet west of Acacia Street, continuing about 19 feet north
Proposed new pole #4590-50 with a sidewalk fixtured anchor and guy wire
Remove secondary conductor from pole #5490 to pole #5485, and install new secondary conductor from new pole #5490-50 to pole #5485 (continued from November 4, 2026)
Memorandum from the Planning Director requesting acceptance of the LAND Grant award for the Magnolia Reserve Conservation project, up to $425,000
location: City Hall – 1st Floor Conference Room, 9 Dale Avenue, Gloucester MA 01930
